verdict.rationale: Telemetry is a fair question for a desktop file converter, but the evidence never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics, or any setting to turn them off. The "Nothing is uploaded… works offline" claim covers file contents staying local, which is an adjacent privacy property, not a documented telemetry opt-out. The in-app update download also shows the app does make some network contact, so local processing cannot stand in for an opt-out.
